calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dm.member_id) AS customer_count
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON fsl.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_member dm ON fsl.member_key = dm.member_key
WHERE s.store_id IN (115, 116, 117, 136)
  AND fsl.member_key IS NOT NULL

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, COUNT(DISTINCT dm.member_id) AS customer_count
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON fsl.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_member dm ON fsl.member_key = dm.member_key
WHERE s.store_id IN (115, 116, 117, 136)
  AND fsl.member_key IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY s.store_id
